system.description:
Your powers were created in a lab and had some unexpected side effects.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.pHoZH9FjeegXJBHE]{Personal Upgrade}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.I3ey6SxXKb8PQn9Z]{Misdirection}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.WdH4qGjjzWilHxVK]{Throw Minion}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.PNXHZkbzkUSgB9MB]{Overpower}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.2aDrJ4JVAxEsT8xD]{Unflagging}
Archetype

Roll d8, d8, d8 for archetype selection.
